content.text: Now I understand the structure. This is a Next.js 16 App Router application. The best way to log all requests is to create a middleware file. Let me create it.

I've created a middleware file at the root of your Next.js app that will log every request to the console. Here's what it does:

**Logging details:**
- Timestamp (ISO format)
- HTTP method (GET, POST, etc.)
- Full URL
- User-Agent header

**What's excluded:**
- Next.js static files (`_next/static`)
- Image optimization requests (`_next/image`)
- `favicon.ico`

The logs will appear in your terminal when you run `npm run dev` or in your production logs. Each request will be logged in this format:
```
[2026-02-16T10:30:45.123Z] GET http://localhost:3000/page - User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0...
```

You can test it by running your dev server and visiting any page in your app.
